comments.author: aeonik
comments.story: Reverse-engineering a carry-lookahead adder in the Pentium
comments.why: Home-made chip fabrication showing DIY processors are accessible
comments.text: While it's not "easy", I was surprised to learn recently that DIY microprocessors are far more accessible than I thought. Here is BreakingTaps fabricating home made chips, he has a fair bit of equipment though [VIDEO] There a a few different techniques that can be used. Most of the lithography techniques use Hydrofluoric Acid, but if you are okay with slower build times you can etch the circuits directly with Ion beams or Electron Beams. But the short story is you need an overhead projector, a microscope, and a few gnarly chemicals. Otherwise fairly straightforward.
